response_texts: Hey, Lalanoah! Did you find the owl there?
Hmm, he wasn't here, but... my friend was sleeping here.
Most likely got blackout drunk and wandered out here... What a nice example you set, friend.
But uncle Brandt, you often sleep outside when you're drunk.
Do I? I remember no such thing. Must have been a long time ago.
Looks like he's not here, either. Lalanoah, if we don't find him in the next place, we probably won't find him at all...
Yeah, I know... I give up on Jhunal...
Hey hey, don't be mad. He could be in the next place. True Nords don't give up until the end.
And you know what? Somehow, when our friend here shows up, things always get better. A true luck bringer, right? Don't worry.
Okay, I'm not giving up until the end. I'll try my best.
Spoken like a true Nord! Let's go, then.
Skoll! Skoll! Come on, let's go!
Skoll, you didn't find Jhunal there, did you? Let's go look for him somewhere else!
Skoll, come on or I'm leaving you behind!
Lost contact with the person in charge of operation Iron Dagger. Contact the agent in Falkreath and head to the scene.
An unknown airship is anchored nearby. Gather the mages on the ramparts and prepare for attack!
What's going on here? I can't stop looting chests even at such a time as this...
There's a lot in here. Yes, this one has perfect supplies. I'll be able to brag about it to my rookie.
Ow! What was that for? Don't you know how to greet a person?
Ku'or ohn? Who you?
Serial number FL-4N. So, what's a child doing in such a place?
You'd better go home. I'm sure your parents are worried about you.
Os Cruviah. Yi ata talig. Looking ata.
Ata, ata, ata... Do you mean your father? I don't know him. What's he like?
Um... Albur fredsho... Same hat.
...A strange hat. Let's look for him together. I'm sure we'll find him soon.
This is it, everyone. There's Arkved!
That's just disgusting... That brain and spinal cord are... Arkved?
There's Arkved's name engraved on the container and biometric information also matches, so it must be him.
Well, then what's with that giant woman in there? I have a bad feeling about this...
This is Zuzu, the giant maiden of Vaermina. She is the Oneiromancer, yes?
Looks like she's dead. No need for us to deal with her, then.
This body is just a shell. Her soul resides in Quagmire and from there she sends dreams to inform witches of threats. Threats like us, no?
I see. So this is why we can't find the elder witches and their Red Drop. It's all her work.
Yes. You must hunt down the Oneiromancer. Then the secrets will be revealed.
Now, bring this one Arkved, rookie. You will be fine, yes?
What are you doing? We need to hurry.
Oh, Ozwald, please don't disturb me. I've almost found him now...
We have nothing to do with the Thalmor here. Don't forget our purpose for coming here.
Yes, I understand, Ozwald.
All researchers should evacuate immediately after destroying the experiments. Repeat, all researchers should evacuate immediately after destroying the experiments.
Right! Right! Go right!
They are here. That's far enough! Prepare the automaton. I'll deal with them myself.
Love, I and We. Love, nipping at observer's strings. I, seeping into walls of jealousy. We, blotting with erasing bread.
I and Ozwald, a total of three who fall into the bending light. Thirty-six repeating and one that goes mad. That is I.
I, that is three times three in a row. Mud and filth, that is Love. We, those who love the maggot springing up from scars of Time!
Oh, I'm in trouble... The trace is here, but... Where on Nirn did our rookie go?
Hey, Kalka... What should I do?
What does Ms. Hamah want to do?
I want to reconcile... But it's hard. I said such terrible things... And I wrote a note about going away...
Am I just going to be all alone again? Oh, why did I do that...
Then it might be best to return soon. Your welcoming party is already here, it seems.
Yep... Thanks for listening, Kalka.
Of course. Come back again any time, Ms. Hamah.
O raging soul, o tainted soul. Do not do this. This is not the Mother's wish.
We are all part of Kyne's Feast of Love...
The witch hunt in Alcaire was a difficult one. Khajiit had to sacrifice dozens of hunters.
But that is only to be expected when hunting down a Psijic, no? But Ja'zel admits, it did not occur to him that the Psijic could change even the course of time.
However, it is possible to kill them if one only tries hard enough, yes? As you can see here...
Ah, a newcomer! Wait here a bit!
Ja'cobee! Ja'cobeeeee! A newcomer is here!
Newcomer? What kind, hmm?
I am not sure, maybe a cat?
Oh, it does not matter... Anyone is welcome...
Welcome to Khajiit's dream. You are this one's second uninvited guest.
This one is called Ja'cobee, the last of the loathsome Chick Traders.
Look, uncle Brandt is back already.
Hey, how come you're only now returning? You're late. Did you stray off the path?
We didn't... We were just talking a bit.
Come on, get inside quickly. Groll's snack must be getting cold already.
Well, then we have to hurry. You'll have to get in quickly too, or there'll be nothing left for you, uncle Brandt!
You can eat my share today. Now go, quickly.
Uncle Brandt, I love you!
Is this... the end for me... Will I perish here, achieving nothing...?
Boltzmer, you must not give up. The experiment has only just begun.
Ah, Professor... So you've been here all along. I leave the rest to you.
Come, my dear Boltzmer. Let us go together, to the Blue Star.
Do you have the gold?
It's all gone now... But...
No. You know the rules. No gold, no bread.
I'm sorry...
Why are you still here, Lalanoah? Don't expect any handouts from me.
The jarl strictly forbade me that. Now that you know this, hurry back home.
But... On the way home...
Stop pestering me and go home now.
Well... Can I just stay here for a while?
Oh, have it your way. But as I said to you over and over, don't go into the town. I don't want to dirty my axe with a brat's blood.
Yep...
If that is your choice, then there is nothing more I can do with this fate...
I will leave this fate, then. I will find and bet on a different you, one who would walk a different fate.
